title: The Whole Front in Glass
hook: You are alongside. The pass is not done.
scene: Rain at night on Central, a box doing thirty in the right. You are in the left, mid-pass, the Ledger's nose past his cab. Recovering now would put your rear doors in his windshield. Skill nine said: see the whole front in the glass, then come back. The arterial wants you humble about how long a bus is.
decision: Your nose is past him. When do you come back?

options.text: Now — you are ahead, and the right is yours again
options.result: You recover on a guess. His windshield fills with your rear doors. He stands on it. You taught him that a pass is a suggestion.

options.text: When his whole front is in your glass and the bus is clear, then signal and recover
options.result: You wait until the box is a box in the mirror, not a wall at your hip. You signal, come back, cancel. He never had to lift. That is a finished pass.

options.text: Stay in the left after you pass — through traffic can live here
options.result: You become the new slow in the passing lane. Everyone who needed the left now needs you. Keep-right did not expire because you passed once.

options.text: Cut in tight to teach him thirty is not a speed
options.result: You give him a breath of asphalt at night in the rain. A box cannot stop on a breath. You spent his margin to make a point.

debrief: Finish the pass. Recover only when the passed vehicle's whole front is in your mirror and you are clear. Then get out of the left.

source.psdp_skill: Skill nine: multi-lane roads – part two
source.teaching_target: Complete a multi-lane pass only when the full front of the passed vehicle is visible in the mirror.

image_brief.subject: day-cab cube truck, short cargo box, still beside the Ledger in the glass, not yet a full front — factory mirrors only, no amber destination sign, no roof rack, no west-coast arms, no cutaway shuttle body
image_brief.foreground: rearview housing, rain on the glass
image_brief.midground: the cube truck's face incomplete in the reflection — you are not clear
image_brief.read: the passed vehicle's whole front is not yet in the glass

geometry.ego_lane_side: left travel lane of two southbound lanes
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: not in the mirror; reflected traffic is behind and beside
